noticias.titulo: Datasite Partners with Prudentia Sciences to Accelerate Life Sciences Diligence | Markets Insider
noticias.resumo: MINNEAPOLIS, Oct.  29, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Datasite, the essential infrastructure for mergers and acquisitions (M&A), today announced a partnership with Prudentia Sciences, a pioneer in AI-native dealmaking technology for life sciences.  The partnership connects approved transaction materials in Datasite data rooms with Prudentia’s AI-powered scientific diligence workflows.
